title: P-only homotopy shrinking
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], P a cochain complex of O_Y-modules [def-pc-derived-category] supported in [0,d], d≥0, with every term finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let y∈V for an open V of Y, and fix endomorphisms a,b of P restricted to V. Suppose their termwise pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback] along V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV are homotopic. Then there are W≤V containing y and a homotopy between the restrictions of these fixed maps a,b to W.

source.place: Proof, first two paragraphs: local unit-entry cancellation and extension of the finite calculation; finite matrix homotopy identities after shrinking

proof.text: Choose a stalk homotopy and termwise finite bases. Only reverse-degree components with both degrees in [0,d] can be nonzero, hence only finitely many scalar coefficients are involved. Restriction and pullback of free modules preserve the bases.

Represent all these coefficients by sections near y inside V, using the stalk construction, and intersect the finitely many opens. The matrices define actual reverse-degree module maps on this open, with other components zero.

The entries of a-dh-hd-b have zero germs. Shrink for each of the finitely many entries using the germ equality criterion and intersect. The homotopy equations then hold in [0,d], and outside that interval they hold because the terms are zero objects. The components are supported only on the reverse differential relation, so the Homotopy.zero fields also hold.

proof_origin.place: Explicit finite matrix argument split from lem-pc-finite-free-stalk-homotopy-pair-shrink, steps 1--3; this half is independent of the other map pair.

theorem exists_shrink_homotopy_P_of_stalk
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y) (V : Y.Opens) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (a b : (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P) ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P))
    (hP : Nonempty (Homotopy
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map a)
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map b))) :
    ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map a)
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map b))
